cardinality.rule: setDisplaySetPresentation: a member of a type of the application on a Cornerstone type, its name in 6.0 is setDisplaySetAppearance
getDisplaySetPresentation: a member of a type of the application on a Cornerstone type, its name in 6.0 is getDisplaySetAppearance

setDisplaySets: the key options.presentation: Cornerstone has no mount option presentation and never read it: set the look after the mount with viewport.setDisplaySetAppearance(displaySetId, appearance)
addDisplaySet: the key presentation: Cornerstone has no mount option presentation and never read it: set the look after the mount with viewport.setDisplaySetAppearance(displaySetId, appearance)
setDisplaySetPresentation: the object has a type of the application, which declares the member: change it there and here, its name in 6.0 is setDisplaySetAppearance
setDisplaySetPresentation: its name in 6.0 is setDisplaySetAppearance
getDisplaySetPresentation: its name in 6.0 is getDisplaySetAppearance
